items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: I don't know. Kid Oliver. Oh, but that man could blow some trumpet.

ctx.x: Second Magazine. Second Magazine. Well, that was a fancy neighborhood in them days. The Bontong people lived all out there in them days. Then, you see, the Irish town was divided from them. But after...

Excuse me. His first name was Joe Oliver. Joe, I said. But everybody in town didn't have a call. They called him Kid Oliver. Kid Oliver. I don't know. Kid Oliver. Oh, but that man could blow some trumpet.
He had a big eye. That's right. That's right. That's right.
